ruled_out_as_primary_explanations: No duplicate full live JSON decode in journal and no repeated canonical fold in normal prepared movement handoff.
No evidence currently isolates filesystem flush/rename as the dominant cost.
Command 56 next choices reply arrives 469.661 ms, after motion 319.538 ms; it is not that motion gate.
Receipt HOL exists behind synchronous event work, but measured preview/command enqueue-to-send maximum is 2.649 ms. Do not add receipt delay as another motion cost or blame 1 ms polling.
Seq 87 has 2494 integer tokens and 18 decimals, all 5.0; general decimal-conversion changes are not justified by this packet.
